study_label: Stage 23 PH2 external follow-up; previously used cohort, not untouched independent validation
exclusion_policy: Exclude all atypical nevi because the seven-class HAM output has no direct frozen label mapping; no casewise exclusions after predictions
preprocessing: PH2 original BMP decoded RGB; convert to BGR; frozen src/preprocessing.py preprocessing; OpenCV default JPEG encode/decode in memory; convert to RGB; Resize 384x384, ToTensor, ImageNet mean/std; no mask/ROI/TTA

inference.selective_policy: resnet.nonlocal3 q@k torch.bmm only in FP32

prediction_policy: Seven-class argmax without threshold; nv/mel retained as named classes, all other predictions grouped as OTHER for mapped 2x3 confusion and count as incorrect
binary_policy: For binary MEL decision, MEL argmax is positive and every other argmax is negative; continuous ROC/AUC score is unmodified seven-class p_mel. Specificity counts true NV with argmax other than MEL, including OTHER; report this beside the 2x3 table to expose its different meaning.
primary_endpoint: MEL argmax recall among 40 true PH2 melanomas, with Wilson 95% interval
secondary_endpoints: p_mel ROC AUC and average precision

uncertainty.binomial: Wilson two-sided 95% for MEL recall, NV recall, binary specificity and mapped accuracy
uncertainty.non_binomial: fixed-seed 42, 2000 stratified image-ID bootstrap percentile resamples; ID is a lesion proxy, patient linkage unavailable; undefined replicates recorded

output_policy: One new result directory, exclusive-create outputs, no checkpoint or source-image edits; source/output SHA256 manifest
selection_policy: No training, fine-tuning, calibration fit, cutoff selection, checkpoint replacement, preprocessing change or model selection from PH2 outcomes
independence_limitation: PH2 was used earlier in this project for diagnostics and older-model evaluations; a new untouched external cohort is required for confirmatory independent validation
